emails.subject: {{first_name}}, quick question
emails.body:
{{first_name}}, noticed {{company_name}} has a solid SDR team.

Curious, do you have a coverage plan for when someone goes on parental leave? Or does the rest of the team just absorb it?

{{first_name}}, only asking because a few teams we work with lost 2-3 months of pipeline before they realized the gap. We helped them keep coverage going without hiring or retraining anyone.

Can I share how they set it up?
